# ESTELUX Istanbul — Complete Clinical, Pricing & Patient Journey Reference

## Brand Overview
- **Name**: ESTELUX Istanbul
- **Domain**: https://esteluxclinic.net
- **Tagline**: Look Beautiful, Live Healthy — Excellence in Medical Care (تألّق بجمالك، وعِش بصحة)
- **City / Country**: Istanbul, Türkiye
- **Direct WhatsApp & Coordinator Desk**: +90 555 056 55 52 (https://wa.me/905550565552)
- **Accreditations**: JCI & ISO Certified Partner Clinics & Hospitals in Istanbul

## 4-Step International Patient Journey
1. **Step 01 — Free Online Smile Assessment**: Patients send dental photos or a panoramic X-ray via WhatsApp (+90 555 056 55 52) or the online form at https://esteluxclinic.net/#consultation. Senior prosthodontists and oral surgeons deliver an itemized treatment plan and fixed price quote within 24 hours.
2. **Step 02 — VIP Airport Pickup & 5-Star Hotel Check-In**: Private Mercedes-Benz chauffeur pickup at Istanbul Airport (IST) or Sabiha Gökçen Airport (SAW), transfer to a curated 5-star partner hotel near the clinic, and scheduled clinic transportation.
3. **Step 03 — 3D Digital Smile Design & Painless Treatment**: 3D CBCT tomography and digital intraoral scanning (no messy putty impressions). Patients test a 3D physical mock-up of their new smile before final bonding.
4. **Step 04 — Final Reveal & Written International Warranty**: Bite verification, final polishing, delivery of serial-numbered material authenticity cards (Ivoclar Vivadent® / Straumann® / Nobel Biocare®), and a 10-year to lifetime written warranty certificate.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
### How many days do I need to stay in Istanbul for a Hollywood Smile or Zirconia Crowns?
A stay of 5 to 7 days in Istanbul is sufficient for E-Max® porcelain veneers or German zirconia crowns, involving 3 to 4 comfortable clinic appointments.

### How long does Dental Implant treatment take?
Visit 1 takes 3 to 5 days for 3D-guided implant placement and temporary fixed teeth. After 3 to 4 months of bone healing (osseointegration), Visit 2 takes 5 to 6 days to fit the permanent zirconia or porcelain bridge/crowns.

### Are dental treatments at ESTELUX painful?
No. All procedures use modern digital local anesthesia (with sedation options available) for a pain-free experience, alongside full post-care medication.

### What warranty is provided?
ESTELUX provides a 10-year written international warranty on E-Max® veneers and German zirconia crowns, and a lifetime warranty on Swiss/German titanium dental implants, accompanied by manufacturer serial cards.

### How do patients from Germany, Ireland, the UK, or GCC book?
Patients can request a complimentary assessment at https://esteluxclinic.net/#consultation or message +90 555 056 55 52 on WhatsApp in English, Arabic, German, or Turkish.
